critical_warnings.detail:
No common node between related clocks  
The clocks io_clk_pcie_00_clk_p and dma_ip_axi_aclk_1 are related (timed together) but they have no common node. The design could fail in hardware. To find a timing path between these clocks, run the following command: report_timing -from [get_clocks io_clk_pcie_00_clk_p] -to [get_clocks dma_ip_axi_aclk_1]
